19.09.2024 CRLA No. 527 of 2024
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Hon’ble Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.
Ms. Suraiya Naaz, learned counsel for the 
appellant.
2. Ms. Pushpa Bhatt, learned D.A.G. along with 
Mr. Sandeep Sharma, learned Brief Holder for the 
State. 
3. This appeal has been preferred by the appellant 
against the impugned judgment and order dated 
12/13.08.2024 passed by learned F.T.S.C./Additional 
Session Judge, Rudrapur, District Udham Singh 
Nagar in S.S.T. No.519/2021, whereby appellant has 
been convicted for the offence punishable under 
Section 6 of POCSO Act and sentenced to undergo 20 
years’ rigorous imprisonment along with fine of Rs. 
50,000/-. 
4. As per the office report, appeal is within time.
5. Admit the appeal.
6. T.C.R. be summoned. 
7. The Registry is directed to prepare paper book 
after receiving the T.C.R. and supply the same to the 
learned counsel for the parties on their request, as per 
Rules.
8. List the matter on 30.12.2024.
9. Meanwhile, State counsel may file objection to 
the bail application.
(Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.) (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 
 19.09.2024
BS/Akash
